purpose: Document city-scope registry and public parcel-geometry source review for the exact WUP ranked settlement point; retain only safe geometry evidence.
assessment: Registers of Scotland publishes the Glasgow City Council (`GLA`) INSPIRE cadastral-parcel archive, updated 27 August 2026. The 37,268,375-byte public ZIP contains an EPSG:27700 `GLA_bng` Polygon shapefile and DBF with `inspireid` as a 23-character string key. A bounded anonymous GET fetched the full public archive. Reading only the INSPIRE ID column found 114,802 nonblank, distinct IDs; SHP/DBF counts match. Geometry-only selection retained three valid complete polygons, each covering the exact WUP point; GEOS reports pairwise intersections/overlaps among the three. The source states these are indicative registered title extents, with gaps/overlaps and titles absent; it is not exact legal boundary evidence or a complete cadastral coverage claim.
registryAssessment: Registers of Scotland publishes a Glasgow City Council INSPIRE cadastral-parcel partition. Geometry-only inspection verifies three current indicative registered-title extent polygons covering the exact WUP point; this is not a legal-boundary or complete parcel-coverage assertion.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official dataset listing identifies Registers of Scotland cadastral parcels, all-Scotland scope and quarterly updates; the Glasgow City Council partition is separately downloadable. Listing indicates update 27 Aug 2026.

Official specification describes the schema, `inspireid` as the parcel identifier, polygons as indicative title ground parcels, and warns that gaps/overlaps and missing titles are expected; the data does not define legal boundaries.
Official Registers of Scotland INSPIRE download service lists the Glasgow authority code GLA and provides the public archive endpoint. Service page presents Open Government Licence 3 terms.

serviceChecks.method: GET Range bytes=0-65535, then bounded archive GET
serviceChecks.observation: Anonymous official GLA ZIP; components are dated 25 Aug 2026. Range response confirms the archive is within the authorized 64 MiB bound; archive checksum recorded in city record.
Content-Range total 37,268,375; ETag and Last-Modified are recorded without retaining the signed redirect URL/query parameters.
Polygon layer and native INSPIRE ID schema confirmed; legal/coverage limitations reviewed.

privacy: Only `inspireid` and geometry are retained. Although additional DBF columns exist, no non-key attribute values were read or retained. No owner/address/property lookup was requested.

viewerAndServiceTrace.clientInspection: Official Registers of Scotland download interface and its GLA endpoint were traced. The public static vector ZIP has paired BNG/Etrs89 shapefiles; metadata inspection was schema-first and full archive was fetched through a bounded anonymous range.
viewerAndServiceTrace.geometryStatus: Three complete full polygons retained; each valid and covers the ranked point. GEOS reports pairwise overlap among all three; overlap is documented without cadastral interpretation.
viewerAndServiceTrace.nativeCoordinatesAndQa: Three native EPSG:27700 geometries and GEOS QA remain in transient /tmp files.

technicalBlocker: The archive has 114,802 nonblank distinct INSPIRE IDs. All three retained native EPSG:27700 polygons are valid and cover the ranked point, but every pair has substantial positive-area overlap (see independent geometry review). No reviewed shapefile snapshot reader, fresh-file identity lookup, bounded viewport completeness or proposal binding is qualified. The runtime remains held without repairing or excluding source polygons. Indicative-title and partial-coverage notices describe scope and do not determine eligibility; server paging is not required for a complete static snapshot.
remainingUncertainty: The title extent product omits a material fraction of titles, may contain gaps/overlaps, and is not an exact legal boundary source. Runtime source refresh and feature identity continuity are also unqualified.
rightsAndCoverage: Official dataset listing last updated 2026-08-27; archive components 2026-08-25. OGL3 stated by the publisher page. Official specification says index extents are indicative, partial, may overlap or omit titles, and are not legal boundaries. The official specification estimates approximately 30% of titles are absent from this dataset.
